title: TC LMS SG - Tertiary Courses
shortDescription: Classes, attendance, materials & certificates for learners and trainers.
fullDescription:
TC LMS SG is the app for learners and trainers of Tertiary Courses Singapore (www.tertiarycourses.com.sg). Sign in with your website email and everything about your classes is in one place.

SIGN IN YOUR WAY
• Get a one-time code by email, or use your website password.

MY CLASSES
• See your current, upcoming and past classes with dates, times, venue or online class link, and trainer.
• Trainers see the classes they teach (WSQ and non-WSQ) next to the classes they attend, marked Teaching or Attending.
• Join live online classes in one tap.

CLASS REMINDERS
• Get a reminder 3 days before a class, the evening before each class day, and on the morning of each class. Turn reminders off at any time in Account.

DIGITAL ATTENDANCE
• Learners check in to the current session from their phone.
• Trainers take attendance for each session and show a check-in QR code for learners to scan.

CLASS MATERIALS
• Open slides, learner guide, lesson plan, labs and PDFs inside the app.
• Trainers also get their trainer courseware.

COURSE FEEDBACK
• Complete the in-house course feedback survey right in the app. Trainers see how many learners have responded.

CALENDAR
• A month view of your class days, and "Add My Classes to Calendar" for your phone's calendar.

CERTIFICATES AND BILLING
• View and share your certificates once they are issued.
• See your course registrations, payment status and invoice numbers.

YOUR PROFILE
• Edit your name and phone number.
• Choose Light, Dark or System appearance; your choice is saved to your account.

BROWSE COURSES
• Explore our non-WSQ short courses, see durations and fees, and enquire on WhatsApp.

Your learner account is created when you register for a course on www.tertiarycourses.com.sg. Trainers sign in with their trainer account. You can delete a learner account at any time from Account → Delete Account.
releaseNotes:
New in 1.5:
